# Step 1: Obtain Initial Metadata from Each Project

This step sets the project directory, loads the raw SRA metadata, and optionally merges supplement tables.

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =============================================================
# Curation Notes - PRJEB1799
# age        : From initial_meta column 'AGE'
# age_info   : NA --- no per-sample age group; paper has infant/child/adult but not per-sample mapping
# bmi        : NA --- not available in metadata or paper
# sex        : From initial_meta 'sex'; 47=M, 48=F per family_relationship column
# subject_id : From initial_meta 'anonymized_name' (e.g., FS_07)
# platform   : Paper Methods --- Illumina GAIIx
# region     : Paper Methods --- V2 hypervariable region of 16S rRNA
# pcr_primers: NA --- paper gives primer sequences only, no standard primer names for V2
# country    : From initial_meta 'geo_loc_name_country' = USA
# site       : From initial_meta 'body_site'; stripped "UBERON:" prefix
#              -> "skin of hand" (338), "face" (169), "tongue" (170), "feces" (169), "foot skin" (2)
# site_group : "oral" for tongue, "gut" for feces, "other" for skin sites (face, skin of hand, foot skin)
# disease_study : "no" --- healthy cohort of 73 families
# is_time_series: "no" --- cross-sectional, single time point per subject
# matched_samples : "pending" --- subjects have multiple body sites (palm, tongue, stool, forehead), resolved by ave()
# controls   : none found in metadata or paper
# non-human  : host_taxid column, value "9615" (Canis lupus familiaris); catches ALL 221 dog samples
#              including 181 "organismal metagenomes", 36 "gut metagenome", and 4 mislabeled as "human"
# body_site filter: none -- all human samples retained for meta-analysis (host_taxid=9606 only)
# =============================================================

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)
library(tools)

# (1) Setting working directory
# EDIT HERE: change project_id for each study
project_id <- "PRJEB1799"

base_dir <- "E:/oral/26/metadata-2604/Oral-Metadata-merge-YL/pair/260518/single pair/"
setwd(file.path(base_dir, project_id))

# (2) Loading raw SRA metadata file
sra_file <- "SraRunTable.csv"
initial_meta <- read.csv(sra_file, header = TRUE)

# (3) OPTIONAL: If extra metadata (e.g., Table.x or supplemental materials) are available from the article, you may need to merge the file with initial_meta manually. Below is example code for merging. Depending on the specific case of each study, you can customize the code as needed.
```

# Step 3: Removing Control and Non-human Samples

First, we need to remove control samples(including both negative controls and positive controls) and non-human samples.

```{r}
# (1) Parameter setup
# From CSV host_taxid: 9606 = Homo sapiens (human, 848 rows), 9615 = Canis lupus familiaris (dog, 221 rows)
# host_taxid is the most reliable indicator: catches all dog samples including mislabeled ones
#   - 181 rows labeled "organismal metagenomes" (host_taxid=9615)
#   - 36 rows labeled "gut metagenome" (host_taxid=9615)
#   - 4 rows mislabeled as "human skin/oral metagenome" but host_taxid=9615 (metadata entry error)
# Negative controls: searched all columns for "negative", "blank", "NTC", "water", "no template"; none found
control_column <- ""   # column name in initial_meta; no controls in this study
# unique(initial_meta[[control_column]])
control_keywords <- c()     # Enter exact keywords

species_column <- "host_taxid"          # column name in initial_meta
unique(initial_meta[[species_column]])
non_human_keywords <- c("^9615$")            # 9615 = Canis lupus familiaris (dog taxon ID); catches all 221 dog samples


# (2) Remove controls and non-human samples. DO NOT need to modify code in this part, just run it.
n_samples <- nrow(initial_meta)
# Control evaluation
if (length(control_keywords) > 0) {
  if (is.null(control_column) || control_column == "") {
    stop("Error: control_keywords provided but control_column is missing.")
  }
  
  if (!(control_column %in% colnames(initial_meta))) {
    stop(sprintf("Error: Column '%s' not found in initial_meta.", control_column))
  }
  
  control_pattern <- paste(control_keywords, collapse = "|")
  control_text <- initial_meta[[control_column]]
  is_control <- grepl(control_pattern, control_text)
  
} else {
  is_control <- rep(FALSE, n_samples)
}

# Non-human evaluation
if (length(non_human_keywords) > 0) {
  if (is.null(species_column) || species_column == "") {
    stop("Error: non_human_keywords provided but species_column is missing.")
  }
  
  if (!(species_column %in% colnames(initial_meta))) {
    stop(sprintf("Error: Column '%s' not found in initial_meta.", species_column))
  }
  
  non_human_pattern <- paste(non_human_keywords, collapse = "|")
  species_text <- initial_meta[[species_column]]
  is_non_human <- grepl(non_human_pattern, species_text)
} else {
  is_non_human <- rep(FALSE, n_samples)
}

# Execute removal
samples_to_remove <- is_control | is_non_human
initial_meta <- initial_meta[!samples_to_remove, ]

cat("Initial samples counts:",n_samples,"\n")
cat("Removed control samples:", sum(is_control), "\n")
cat("Removed non-human samples:", sum(is_non_human), "\n")
cat("Total samples removed ", sum(samples_to_remove), "\n")
cat("Remaining samples after Step 2:", nrow(initial_meta), "\n")

# (3) Keep all human samples after dog removal
# After filtering host_taxid=9615 (221 dog samples removed), all remaining 848 samples are human (host_taxid=9606)
# Human samples by body_site: "UBERON:skin of hand" (338), "UBERON:face" (169), "UBERON:tongue" (170), "UBERON:feces" (169), "UBERON:foot skin" (2)
# No further filtering by body_site; all human samples retained for meta-analysis
cat("All human samples retained:", nrow(initial_meta), "\n")
```

# Step 4: Creating a Uniform Metadata Template

This step converts the raw SRA table into the standard metadata format used in our meta-analysis.
The uniform metadata should include the following columns:
1. **bioproject**: Project ID from SRA or other database
   e.g. `PRJNA1234`, `CNP1234`, 'OEP1234', 'qiita_1234'
2. **sample_id**: SRA sample/run ID. Unique id for each sample!
   e.g. `DRR1234567`, `ERR1234567` and `SRR1234567`. If no such column exists, can use column like sample_name.
3. **subject_id**: subject id for each person if available.
   e.g. `patient_01`, `Host_03_before`, `subject12`
4. **age**: Age of the subject if available.
   e.g. `35`, `42` | not `adult`, `chilren`
5. **age_info**: If the age is not explicitly stated but approximate age range information is available, mark it in this column.
   e.g., `18-55`, `children`, `infant`, `elder`
6. **bmi**: Body Mass Index if available.
   e.g. `22.5`, `18.9` | not `normal`, `overweight`
7. **sex**: Sex of the subject.
   Mandatory to write as M/F | not `female`, `woman`
8. **sequencing_region**: Targeted 16S rRNA region.
   e.g. `V3-V4`, `V4` 
9. **platform**: Sequencing platform.
   e.g. `Illumina MiSeq`, `454 GS FLX Titanium`, `Ion Torrent`
10. **country**: Country of sample origin.
   e.g. `China`, `Japan` | not city name like `Beijing`
11. **site**: Sampling site. For oral and gut sites, specify the exact sites as detailed as possible. For example, if it is known to be supragingival plaque, do not record it as 'dental plaque', unless the original text provides only a vague description. 
    e.g. `saliva`, `tongue coating` | not broad term like `oral`
12. **site_group**: only accepts one of following three values: 'oral', 'gut', or 'other'.
13. **public_time**: Data release date. 
    e.g. `2021-06-22` | not `June 2021`
14. **pcr_primers**: PCR primers used.
    e.g. `515F-806R`, `27F-338R` | not primer sequences
15. **title**: Title of the associated publication.
16. **disease_study**: Whether the study involves disease samples. If it's not clear, can record as NA. Only three values accepted: 'yes', 'no' or NA
17. **status**: Disease status for each sample if available, else record as NA. Only accept following abbreviations, Write full names for all other diseases.
    HC: healthy control
    CD: Crohn's disease
    CRC: colorectal cancer
    COPD: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
    HIV: human immunodeficiency virus
    ICU: intensive care unit
    OSCC: oral squamous cell carcinoma
    RA: rheumatoid arthritis
    UC: ulcerative colitis
18. **matched_samples**: Whether the subject has matched samples. Only accept 'yes' or 'no'.
19. **is_time_series**: Whether the study is a time series study. Only accept 'yes' or 'no'.

```{r}
# Extract columns from initial_meta as follows: (1) No modification needed -> extract directly. (2) Modification needed -> create a new column with the prefix raw_ and mark the original column as "pending". (3) Need to find or determine based on the article.
metadata <- data.frame(
  bioproject = initial_meta$BioProject,                          # From initial_meta column 'BioProject' = PRJEB1799
  sample_id = initial_meta$Run,                                  # From initial_meta column 'Run' (e.g., ERR261869)
  subject_id = initial_meta$anonymized_name,                     # From initial_meta column 'anonymized_name' (e.g., FS_07)
  age = initial_meta$AGE,                                        # From initial_meta column 'AGE'
  age_info = NA,                                                 # Age group info not explicitly available per individual; paper has infant/child/adult categories but not per-sample mapping
  bmi = NA,                                                      # Not available in metadata or paper
  raw_sex = initial_meta$sex,                                    # From initial_meta column 'sex'; 47=M, 48=F per family_relationship column
  sex = "pending",                                               # will convert from raw_sex
  sequencing_region = "V2",                                      # Paper Methods: "V2 hypervariable region of 16S rRNA"
  platform = "Illumina GAIIx",                                   # Paper Methods: "Illumina GAIIx"; NOT from metadata
  country = initial_meta$geo_loc_name_country,                   # From initial_meta column 'geo_loc_name_country' = USA
  raw_site = initial_meta$body_site,                             # From initial_meta column 'body_site' = "UBERON:skin of hand"
  site = "pending",                                              # will strip UBERON prefix
  site_group = "pending",                                        # will set based on site
  public_time = initial_meta$ReleaseDate,                        # From initial_meta column 'ReleaseDate'
  pcr_primers = NA,                                              # Paper Methods gives primer sequences only, not standard primer names; V2 region primers used
  title = "Prevalence and Source of Fecal and Oral Bacteria on Infant, Child, and Adult Hands", # Paper title
  disease_study = "no",                                          # Paper studies healthy cohort (73 families, general population)
  status = NA,                                                   # No disease status; healthy subjects
  matched_samples = "pending",                                   # subjects have multiple body sites (palm, tongue, stool, forehead)
  is_time_series = "no",                                         # Cross-sectional design; single time point per subject
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
metadata$public_time <- as.Date(metadata$public_time)
```

# Step 5: Manually solving pending issues

This step involves two parts: (1) handle the columns with the `raw_` prefix, and next (2) handle the `site_group` and `matched_samples` columns.

```{r}
# (1) Handle the columns with the `raw_` prefix.
# In this part, you need to customize the code based on the situation of the raw_ columns to obtain the content of the target columns. IMPORTANT: Add comments if the modification is not straightforward!!
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(sex = case_when(
    raw_sex == 47 ~ "M",
    raw_sex == 48 ~ "F",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) # From initial_meta 'sex' column: 47=male, 48=female per family_relationship column
metadata$site <- gsub("UBERON:", "", metadata$raw_site)  # From initial_meta 'body_site'; strips "UBERON:" prefix -> "skin of hand"
```

```{r}
# (2) Filling the 'site_group' and 'matched_samples' columns
# editing site_group
unique(metadata$site)
# EDIT HERE: add oral sites
# From initial_meta 'body_site': "UBERON:tongue" -> "tongue" after stripping UBERON prefix
Oral_site = c("tongue")
# EDIT HERE: add gut sites
# From initial_meta 'body_site': "UBERON:feces" -> "feces" after stripping UBERON prefix
Gut_site = c("feces")
# just run
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(site_group = case_when(
    site %in% Oral_site ~ "oral",
    site %in% Gut_site ~ "gut",
    TRUE ~ "other"  # "skin of hand", "face", "foot skin" -> "other" (skin sites)
  ))

# editing matched_samples, just run.
metadata$matched_samples <- ifelse(
  ave(metadata$subject_id, metadata$subject_id, FUN = length) > 1, 
  "yes", 
  "no"
)
```

```{r}
# (3) check if there is pending value in metadata. If there is pending value, go on modify the metadata.
# Function to check if a column contains "pending"
has_pending <- function(col) {
  if (is.character(col) || is.factor(col)) {
    any(col == "pending", na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    FALSE
  }
}

# Check for any pending value
any_pending_value <- any(sapply(metadata, has_pending))

if (!any_pending_value) {
  message("Good! No cell contains the value 'pending'.")
} else {
  pending_cols <- names(metadata)[sapply(metadata, has_pending)]
  message("Columns containing 'pending': ", paste(pending_cols, collapse = ", "))
  message("Please continue to resolve these pending columns!")
}
```

# Step 6: Column Cleaning for Merger and Analysis
# Note : Do not change the code here !!!

This step is to clean some of the 19 columns collected previously for merging into the summary table and subsequent analysis.

```{r}
# Define the core cleaning function
generate_cleaned_cols <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      # Age Cleaning 
      age_cleaned = case_when(
        str_detect(as.character(age), "(?i)week") ~ as.character(as.numeric(str_replace_all(as.character(age), "[^0-9.]", "")) / 52),
        TRUE ~ as.character(age) 
      ),
      age_numeric = as.numeric(age_cleaned),
      
      age_cleaned_group_base = case_when(
        !is.na(age_numeric) & (age_numeric < 0 | age_numeric > 150) ~ "Anomaly",
        !is.na(age_numeric) & age_numeric <= 0.5 ~ "0-6 months",
        !is.na(age_numeric) & age_numeric > 0.5 & age_numeric <= 3 ~ "6-36 months",
        !is.na(age_numeric) & age_numeric > 3 & age_numeric <= 12 ~ "3-12 years",
        !is.na(age_numeric) & age_numeric > 12 & age_numeric <= 18 ~ "12-18 years",
        !is.na(age_numeric) & age_numeric > 18 & age_numeric <= 60 ~ "18-60 years",
        !is.na(age_numeric) & age_numeric > 60 ~ "＞60 years",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      age_info_lower = tolower(trimws(as.character(age_info))),

      age_info_cleaned = case_when(
        is.na(age_info_lower) ~ NA_character_,
        age_info_lower %in% c(">=21", "≥21", "1-3 years at enrollment; longitudinal follow-up saliva samples in sra span approximately 1.34-5.57 years", "50+", "8 months-25 years", "age_group_1", "baby", "children", "child", "chilren", "elderly adults", "elder", "full cohort median age 41.5 years; healthy 38 (20-66), gingivitis 43 (18-71), chronic periodontitis 43 (21-60)", "infant", "not provided", "over 18 years", "toddlers 1-3 years; children 4-12 years; teenager-adults 13-59 years", "unspecified") ~ NA_character_,
        age_info_lower %in% c("adult male betel-quid users", "adult male non-smokers; cohort mean age 44 years (range 31-60)", "adult participants; eligibility age >=18 years; total cohort median age 40.0 years (iqr 31.0-50.0)", "adults; group means reported separately by disease severity", "control 30.50±5.74; osa 40.11±11.25; htn 36.22±10.20; osa+htn 42.17±9.52; male adults >18 years", "control non-cp: 34.7 ± 15.9 years; control cp: 46.3 ± 13.2 years; sle non-cp: 31.2 ± 5.2 years; sle cp: 40.5 ± 10.1 years", "healthy dental students; mean age 26.36 +/- 1.58 years") ~ "18-60 years",
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "^\\(\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*,\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*\\)$") ~ case_when(
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 0.5 ~ "0-6 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 3 ~ "6-36 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 12 ~ "3-12 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 18 ~ "12-18 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 60 ~ "18-60 years",
          TRUE ~ "＞60 years"
        ),
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "month") & str_detect(age_info_lower, "\\d+") ~ case_when(
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+")) <= 6 ~ "0-6 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+")) <= 36 ~ "6-36 months",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "^\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*-\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*$") ~ case_when(
          (as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "^\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*")) + as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*$"))) / 2 <= 0.5 ~ "0-6 months",
          (as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "^\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*")) + as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*$"))) / 2 <= 3 ~ "6-36 months",
          (as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "^\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*")) + as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*$"))) / 2 <= 12 ~ "3-12 years",
          (as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "^\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*")) + as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*$"))) / 2 <= 18 ~ "12-18 years",
          (as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "^\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*")) + as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*$"))) / 2 <= 60 ~ "18-60 years",
          TRUE ~ "＞60 years"
        ),
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "average|mean") & !str_detect(age_info_lower, "±|\\+-|;|migraine") & str_detect(age_info_lower, "\\d+") ~ case_when(
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 0.5 ~ "0-6 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 3 ~ "6-36 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 12 ~ "3-12 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 18 ~ "12-18 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 60 ~ "18-60 years",
          TRUE ~ "＞60 years"
        ),
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "\\b[1-9]0s\\b") ~ case_when(
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d{2}")) < 12 ~ "3-12 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d{2}")) < 18 ~ "12-18 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d{2}")) < 60 ~ "18-60 years",
          TRUE ~ "＞60 years"
        ),
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "±") & str_count(age_info_lower, "±") == 1 & str_detect(age_info_lower, "\\d+") ~ case_when(
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 0.5 ~ "0-6 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 3 ~ "6-36 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 12 ~ "3-12 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 18 ~ "12-18 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 60 ~ "18-60 years",
          TRUE ~ "＞60 years"
        ),
        str_detect(age_info_lower, ";") & str_detect(age_info_lower, "25-58 years; migraine mean 39\\.5") ~ "18-60 years",
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "60\\+|above 60") ~ "＞60 years",
        age_info_lower %in% c("adult", "adults") ~ "18-60 years",
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "centenarians") ~ "＞60 years",
        str_count(age_info_lower, "±") >= 2 ~ "18-60 years",
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "child \\(\\d+-year-olds\\)") ~ case_when(
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+")) <= 0.5 ~ "0-6 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+")) <= 3 ~ "6-36 months",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+")) <= 12 ~ "3-12 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+")) <= 18 ~ "12-18 years",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "newborn|preterm infant") ~ "0-6 months",
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "older adults.*±") ~ "＞60 years",
        age_info_lower %in% c("teen", "teenager") ~ "12-18 years",
        age_info_lower == "young adults" ~ "18-60 years",
        str_detect(age_info_lower, "mean.*\\+-") & str_detect(age_info_lower, "\\d+") ~ case_when(
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 18 ~ "12-18 years",
          as.numeric(str_extract(age_info_lower, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")) <= 60 ~ "18-60 years",
          TRUE ~ "＞60 years"
        ),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      age_cleaned_group = case_when(
        !is.na(age_cleaned_group_base) & age_cleaned_group_base != "Anomaly" ~ age_cleaned_group_base,
        !is.na(age_info_cleaned) ~ age_info_cleaned,
        ("raw_host" %in% names(df) && !is.na(df$raw_host) && tolower(trimws(as.character(df$raw_host))) == "pregnant women") ~ "18-60 years",
        !is.na(age_cleaned_group_base) & age_cleaned_group_base == "Anomaly" ~ "Anomaly",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      # BMI Cleaning
      bmi_calc = case_when(
        bioproject == "PRJEB34272" & as.character(bmi) == "not collected" ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ as.character(bmi) 
      ),
      bmi_raw_numeric = as.numeric(bmi_calc),
      bmi_cleaned = case_when(
        bmi_raw_numeric > 50 ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ bmi_calc
      ),
      bmi_numeric = as.numeric(bmi_cleaned),
      bmi_cleaned_group = case_when(
        is.na(bmi_numeric) & bmi_raw_numeric > 50 ~ "Anomaly_High",
        is.na(bmi_numeric) ~ NA_character_,
        bmi_numeric < 0 ~ "Anomaly_High",
        bmi_numeric < 18.5 ~ "＜18.5",
        bmi_numeric >= 18.5 & bmi_numeric < 24.0 ~ "18.5-24.0",
        bmi_numeric >= 24.0 & bmi_numeric < 28.0 ~ "24.0-28.0",
        bmi_numeric >= 28.0 ~ "≥28.0",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      # General Variables Cleaning
      sex_cleaned = case_when(
        bioproject %in% c("PRJDB12092", "PRJNA720269", "PRJDB10426") & as.character(sex) == "female" ~ "F",
        bioproject %in% c("PRJDB12092", "PRJNA720269", "PRJDB10426") & as.character(sex) == "male" ~ "M",
        TRUE ~ as.character(sex)
      ),
      platform_cleaned = case_when(
        is.na(platform) ~ NA_character_,
        bioproject == "PRJNA659632" & as.character(platform) == "ION TORRENT" ~ "Ion Torrent",
        bioproject == "PRJNA745286" & as.character(platform) == "Illumina iSeq 100" ~ "Illumina MiSeq",
        bioproject == "PRJNA362794" & as.character(platform) == "Illumina PE250" ~ "Illumina MiSeq",
        as.character(platform) == "Illumina Miseq" ~ "Illumina MiSeq",
        str_detect(as.character(platform), "(?i)NextSeq") ~ "Illumina NextSeq",
        str_detect(as.character(platform), "(?i)454") ~ "454 GS FLX Titanium",
        str_detect(as.character(platform), "(?i)HiSeq") ~ "Illumina HiSeq",
        str_detect(as.character(platform), "(?i)NovaSeq") ~ "Illumina NovaSeq",
        str_detect(as.character(platform), "(?i)Ion Torrent") ~ "Ion Torrent",
        str_detect(as.character(platform), "(?i)GAIIx|Genome Analyzer IIx") ~ "Illumina GAIIx",
        TRUE ~ as.character(platform)
      ),
      sequencing_region_cleaned = case_when(
        is.na(sequencing_region) ~ NA_character_,
        bioproject == "PRJNA659632" & as.character(sequencing_region) == "V2, V3, V4, V6-7, V8, V9" ~ "V2,V3,V4,V6-V7,V8,V9",
        bioproject == "PRJNA391982" & as.character(sequencing_region) == "V1-V3/V7-V9" ~ "V1-V3,V7-V9",
        str_detect(as.character(sequencing_region), "[–—_]") ~ str_replace_all(as.character(sequencing_region), "[–—_]+", "-"),
        TRUE ~ as.character(sequencing_region)
      ),
      country_cleaned = case_when(
        bioproject == "PRJEB12953" & as.character(country) == "Korean" ~ "Republic of Korea",
        bioproject == "PRJNA489752" & as.character(country) == "Korea" ~ "Republic of Korea",
        bioproject == "PRJEB11419" & as.character(country) == "Korea, Republic of" ~ "Republic of Korea",
        bioproject == "PRJEB11419" & as.character(country) %in% c("Not provided", "Unspecified") ~ NA_character_,
        as.character(country) %in% c("South Korea", "South Korean") ~ "Republic of Korea",
        as.character(country) %in% c("United States of America", "USA", "United States Minor Outlying Islands") ~ "United States",
        TRUE ~ as.character(country)
      ),
      continent_temp = countrycode(country_cleaned, origin = "country.name", destination = "continent", warn = FALSE),
      continent_group = case_when(
        bioproject %in% c("PRJEB12953", "PRJNA489752") ~ "Asia",
        is.na(country_cleaned) ~ NA_character_,
        continent_temp == "Africa" ~ "Africa",
        continent_temp == "Asia" ~ "Asia",
        continent_temp == "Europe" ~ "Europe",
        continent_temp == "Oceania" ~ "Oceania",
        continent_temp == "Americas" & countrycode(country_cleaned, origin="country.name", destination="un.regionsub.name", warn=FALSE) %in% c("Northern America") ~ "North America",
        continent_temp == "Americas" ~ "South America",
        str_detect(tolower(country_cleaned), "antarctica") ~ "Antarctica",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
      ),
      site_lower = tolower(as.character(site)),
      site_cleaned = case_when(
        is.na(site) ~ NA_character_,
        bioproject == "PRJEB4953" & as.character(site) %in% c("Right retromolar trigone", "Right post maxilla ging", "Right floor of mouth", "Right alveolar ridge", "Midline hard palate", "Left retromolar trigone", "Left floor of mouth", "Left alveolar ridge", "floor of Mouth", "floor of mouth") ~ "oral mucosa",
        bioproject == "PRJNA542898" & as.character(site) == "buccal surfaces" ~ "oral mucosa",
        bioproject == "PRJNA412445" & as.character(site) == "mucous" ~ "oral mucosa",
        bioproject == "PRJNA820027" & as.character(site) == "oral_cavity" ~ "other", 
        bioproject == "PRJNA362794" & as.character(site) == "paracancerous tissues" ~ "other",
        bioproject == "PRJNA595346" & as.character(site) == "posterior oropharyngeal swab" ~ "oral swab",
        bioproject == "PRJNA48333" & as.character(site) == "throat" ~ "oral swab",
        bioproject == "PRJNA841771" & as.character(site) == "oral scraping" ~ "other",
        as.character(site) == "Left post mandible ging" ~ "gingiva",
        str_detect(site_lower, "hard palate") ~ "oral mucosa", 
        str_detect(site_lower, "oropharyngeal swab|throat") ~ "oral swab",
        site_lower %in% tolower(c("paracancerous tissues", "paracancerous tissue", "tumor tissue", "tumor", "oral cavity")) ~ "other",
        as.character(site) %in% c("Right post maxilla ging", "implant sulcus") ~ "gingiva",
        as.character(site) == "faucial pillars" ~ "oral mucosa",
        as.character(site) %in% c("oral rinse", "oral washing", "oral lavage") ~ "saliva",
        as.character(site) %in% c("cancer surface", "cancer tissue", "cancerous lesions", "oral", "normal tissue", "oral tissue (location unspecified)", "swab_nasopharynx_or_oropharynx", "cleft") ~ "other",
        str_detect(site_lower, "plaque|supragingival|subgingival|dental|carious dentin tissue|periodontal|carious|dentition") ~ "tooth",
        str_detect(site_lower, "oral wash|mouthwash|mouth wash") ~ "saliva",
        str_detect(site_lower, "mucosa|mucosal|buccal swab|buccal mucosa swabs") ~ "oral mucosa",
        str_detect(site_lower, "tongue") ~ "tongue",
        str_detect(site_lower, "gingiva|gingival") ~ "gingiva",
        str_detect(site_lower, "tonsil") ~ "Other",
        str_detect(site_lower, "oral swab") ~ "oral swab",
        str_detect(site_lower, "saliva") ~ "saliva",
        str_detect(site_lower, "faeces|fecal|feces|gut|rectal swab|rectum|stool") ~ "feces",
        TRUE ~ as.character(site)
      ),
      site_group_cleaned = case_when(
        bioproject == "PRJNA659632" & as.character(site_group) == "other" ~ "oral",
        TRUE ~ as.character(site_group)
      ),
      
      # Disease Study Cleaning
      disease_study_cleaned = case_when(
        bioproject %in% c("PRJEB38610", "PRJEB39420", "PRJEB39436", "PRJNA417321", "PRJNA451534", "PRJNA876796") & tolower(disease_study) == "no" ~ NA_character_,
        bioproject %in% c("PRJNA380250", "PRJNA685840", "PRJNA847970", "PRJNA762545") ~ "yes",
        bioproject %in% c("PRJNA518756", "PRJNA613363", "PRJNA782768") ~ "no",
        TRUE ~ as.character(disease_study)
      ),

      # Status Cleaning
      status_lower = tolower(as.character(status)),
      status_temp = case_when(
        is.na(status) ~ NA_character_,
        status_lower %in% tolower(c("mucositis healed", "pre-conditioning", "atopic non-asthmatic controls", "pre-cancer", "full-term", "allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation recipient", "immunological ART responder", "dentally compromised", "preterm newborns", "preterm", "pulmonary nodule", "thyroid nodules", "black dental stain", "thyroid nodules patient", "epithelial precursor lesion")) ~ NA_character_,
        str_detect(status_lower, "breastfed|full-term|orthodontic|third molar extraction|non-responder|high-risk for ra") ~ NA_character_,
        bioproject == "PRJNA417321" & as.character(status) == "dental implant" ~ NA_character_,
        status_lower %in% tolower(c("halitosis", "dysphagia", "watery diarrhea NOS", "truncal ataxia NOS", "oral benign tumors", "cancer patient", "Carcinoma in situ", "Chronic mucosal inflammation", "acute pancreatitis", "aortic thrombosis", "tibial fracture", "hip fracture", "hypotension", "STEMI", "NSTEMI", "temporal lobe epilepsy", "Fanconi anemia with leukoplakia", "Fanconi anemia with OSCC", "systemic lupus erythematosus with chronic periodontitis", "systemic lupus erythematosus", "acute lymphoblastic leukemia", "helminth infection", "pre-eclampsia", "stomatitis", "early childhood caries and congenital heart disease", "proliferative verrucous leukoplakia", "Refractory Celiac disease", "IBD+Diabetes")) ~ "Other",
        status_lower == tolower("Lung Cancer") ~ "Lung Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("Breast Cancer") ~ "Breast Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("Pancreatic Cancer") ~ "Pancreatic Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("Oral Cancer") ~ "Oral Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("Digestive Tract Cancer") ~ "Digestive Tract Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("Prostate Cancer") ~ "Prostate Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("Esophageal Cancer") ~ "Esophageal Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("Colon Cancer") ~ "Colon Cancer",
        status_lower == tolower("viremic ART-untreated") ~ "HIV",
        status_lower %in% tolower(c("functional dyspepsia and gastroesophageal reflux disease", "GERD", "Reflux Esophagitis", "reflux esophagitis")) ~ "Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease",
        status_lower == tolower("RAU") ~ "Aphthous",
        status_lower == tolower("chronic periodontitis associated with type 2 diabetes mellitus") ~ "Diabetes and Periodontitis",
        bioproject == "PRJNA316469" & as.character(disease_study) == "no" & as.character(status) %in% c("never smoker", "current smoker") ~ "HC",
        bioproject == "PRJEB40804" & as.character(status) == "certified saturation divers with valid health certificates" ~ "HC",
        bioproject == "PRJNA784772" & as.character(status) == "DTC" ~ "differentiated thyroid carcinoma",
        bioproject == "PRJNA656387" & as.character(status) == "first-degree relatives" ~ "HC",
        bioproject == "PRJNA853196" & as.character(status) == "ESCC" ~ "esophageal squamous cell carcinoma",
        bioproject == "PRJDB8324" & as.character(status) == "healthy" ~ "HC",
        bioproject == "PRJNA873789" & as.character(status) == "axSpA" ~ "axial spondyloarthritis",
        bioproject == "PRJEB11419" & as.character(status) == "C.diff" ~ "Clostridium difficile infection",
        bioproject == "PRJEB11419" & as.character(status) == "IBD+C.diff" ~ "IBD and Clostridium difficile infection",
        bioproject == "PRJNA362643" & as.character(status) == "Sjögren’s syndrome" ~ "Sjögren's syndrome",
        bioproject == "PRJNA664107" & as.character(status) == "chronic periodontitis associated with T2DM" ~ "Diabetes and Periodontitis",
        bioproject == "PRJNA663926" & as.character(status) %in% c("hand, foot and mouth disease symptomatic", "hand, foot and mouth disease asymptomatic") ~ "hand, foot and mouth disease",
        bioproject == "PRJNA544600" & as.character(status) == "obstructive sleep apnea syndrome" ~ "obstructive sleep apnea",
        as.character(status) == "caries" ~ "dental caries",
        as.character(status) == "recurrent aphthous ulcer" ~ "aphthous",
        status_lower == tolower("CD and UC") ~ "CD and UC",
        status_lower == tolower("no-OM") ~ "HC",
        str_detect(status_lower, "periodontitis|gingivitis|periodontal|peri-implantitis") ~ "periodontal disease",
        str_detect(status_lower, "caries") ~ "dental caries",
        str_detect(status_lower, "coronavirus disease of 2019|covid") ~ "COVID-19",
        str_detect(status_lower, "chagas") ~ "chagas disease",
        str_detect(status_lower, "hiv") ~ "HIV",
        str_detect(status_lower, "obese|obesity") ~ "obesity",
        str_detect(status_lower, "aphthous") ~ "aphthous",
        str_detect(status_lower, "type 2 diabetes mellitus|t2dm|type-2 diabetes|type 1 diabetes|diabetes") ~ "diabetes",
        str_detect(status_lower, "atherosclerosis") ~ "cardiovascular disease",
        str_detect(status_lower, "oral mucositis|severe-om|grade 1 om") ~ "oral mucositis",
        str_detect(status_lower, "olp") ~ "oral lichen planus",
        str_detect(status_lower, "helicobacter pylori") ~ "helicobacter pylori infection",
        str_detect(status_lower, "thyroid cancer") ~ "thyroid cancer",
        str_detect(status_lower, "cancer") ~ "cancer",
        str_detect(status_lower, "reflux esophagitis") ~ "Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease",
        str_detect(status_lower, "axspa") ~ "axial spondyloarthritis",
        str_detect(status_lower, "nasopharyngeal carcinoma") ~ "nasopharyngeal carcinoma",
        str_detect(status_lower, "oscc|oral squamous cell carcinoma") ~ "OSCC",
        str_detect(status_lower, "head and neck squamous cell carcinoma|hnscc|head and neck cancer|hnc") ~ "head and neck cancer",
        str_detect(status_lower, "cleft lip and palate|clp") ~ "cleft lip and palate",
        str_detect(status_lower, "ad|alzheimer") ~ "Alzheimer's disease",
        str_detect(status_lower, "parkinson") ~ "Parkinson's disease",
        str_detect(status_lower, "post-traumatic stress disorder|ptsd") ~ "PTSD",
        TRUE ~ as.character(status)
      ),
      status_cleaned = ifelse(!is.na(status_temp) & tolower(status_temp) != "na", tools::toTitleCase(status_temp), NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    # Final Case Adjustments and Missing Value Handling
    mutate(across(c(sex_cleaned, platform_cleaned, sequencing_region_cleaned, 
                    country_cleaned, continent_group, site_cleaned, 
                    site_group_cleaned, disease_study_cleaned, status_cleaned),
                  ~ ifelse(!is.na(.), tools::toTitleCase(as.character(.)), NA_character_))) %>%
    mutate(status_cleaned = case_when(
      is.na(status) & bioproject %in% c("PRJEB1799", "PRJEB20889", "PRJEB20890", "PRJEB20894", "PRJEB27304", "PRJEB28088", "PRJEB28769", "PRJEB33119", "PRJEB42056", "PRJEB6518", "PRJNA255332", "PRJNA395436", "PRJNA427101", "PRJNA634162", "PRJNA689848", "PRJNA721325", "PRJNA747639", "PRJNA778070", "PRJNA828039", "PRJNA841067") ~ "HC",
      status_cleaned == "Hiv" ~ "HIV",
      status_cleaned == "Oscc" ~ "OSCC",
      status_cleaned == "Hc" ~ "HC",
      status_cleaned == "Cd And Uc" ~ "CD and UC",
      status_cleaned == "Covid-19" ~ "COVID-19",
      status_cleaned == "Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease" ~ "Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease",
      TRUE ~ status_cleaned
    )) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(age_cleaned, bmi_cleaned, age_cleaned_group, bmi_cleaned_group, sex_cleaned, platform_cleaned, 
               sequencing_region_cleaned, country_cleaned, continent_group, 
               site_cleaned, site_group_cleaned, disease_study_cleaned, status_cleaned),
             ~ ifelse(trimws(.) %in% c("", "NA"), NA_character_, .)),
      age_cleaned_group = ifelse(age_cleaned_group == "Anomaly", NA_character_, age_cleaned_group),
      bmi_cleaned_group = ifelse(bmi_cleaned_group == "Anomaly_High", NA_character_, bmi_cleaned_group)
    ) %>%
    # Remove intermediate computational columns
    select(-age_numeric, -age_cleaned_group_base, -age_info_lower, 
           -bmi_calc, -bmi_raw_numeric, -bmi_numeric, 
           -continent_temp, -site_lower, -status_lower, -status_temp) %>%
    # Remove rows where site_group_cleaned contains "other", keep only "oral" and "gut"
    filter(tolower(site_group_cleaned) %in% c("oral", "gut"))
}

# Execute the core cleaning function
metadata <- generate_cleaned_cols(metadata)
```

# Step 7: Supplement oral-gut pairing information

This step is to create some columns of oral and gut pairing information.

```{r}
# 1. Generate raw_pair_time_point based on timepoint column
# Note : the code must be changed here ! ! !
metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(
    initial_meta %>% select(Run, host_subject_id), 
    by = c("sample_id" = "Run") 
  ) %>%
  
  # Combined with the original text of the article, it can be seen that because the value containing A in the Sample_ID column is triplicate01, the value containing B is triplicate02, and the value containing C is triplicate03, only one value containing A is triplicate01.
# Article: Bacterial DNA was isolated from stool and saliva and this was used to determine the V4 variable region of the 16S rRNA gene sequence composition of the samples in triplicate.
  
  mutate(
    raw_pair_time_point = NA,
    
    # 2. Normalizes the display of the pair_time_point column 
    pair_time_point = NA,
    
    # 3. Combination generates unique pair_id
    pair_id = paste(subject_id, raw_pair_time_point, sep = "_")
  ) 
```

```{r}
# Note : Do not change the code here !!!
# (2) Matching rules to evaluate body sites
gut_pattern <- "(?i)feces|fece|stool|gut"
oral_pattern <- "(?i)saliva|tooth|oral|plaque|tongue|buccal|gingiva"

# (3) Temporarily replace NA and deduplicate at the sample_id level to confirm true site origins
sample_level_data <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    temp_site = replace_na(as.character(site), ""),
    temp_site_group = replace_na(as.character(site_group), ""),
    is_gut = str_detect(temp_site, gut_pattern) | str_detect(temp_site_group, gut_pattern),
    is_oral = str_detect(temp_site, oral_pattern) | str_detect(temp_site_group, oral_pattern)
  ) %>%
  group_by(bioproject, subject_id, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    is_gut = any(is_gut, na.rm = TRUE),
    is_oral = any(is_oral, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(is_gut | is_oral)

# (4) Aggregate on subject_id to evaluate matched pair conditions
subject_stats <- sample_level_data %>%
  group_by(bioproject, subject_id) %>%
  summarise(
    gut_count = sum(is_gut),
    oral_count = sum(is_oral),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(gut_count >= 1 & oral_count >= 1) %>%
  mutate(
    subj_pair_type = if_else(gut_count == 1 & oral_count == 1, "one pair", "many pairs"),
    subj_actual_pairs = pmin(gut_count, oral_count)
  )

# (5) Final summary at the bioproject level
pair_summary <- subject_stats %>%
  group_by(bioproject) %>%
  summarise(
    pair_type = case_when(
      all(subj_pair_type == "one pair") ~ "one pair",
      all(subj_pair_type == "many pairs") ~ "many pairs",
      TRUE ~ "one pair and many pairs"
    ),
    pair_sample_number = sum(subj_actual_pairs),
    pair_subject_number = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# (6) Join pair_summary variables back into the main metadata table
metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(pair_summary, by = "bioproject") %>%
  mutate(pair_bioproject = bioproject)
```

# Step 8: Sort and export the metadata

This step saves the cleaned metadata table as the final `metadata_oral_gut_pair_curation_v2.csv` file.

```{r}
# Note : Do not change the code here !!!
# 1. Recover unselected original metadata from initial_meta
cols_to_add <- setdiff(names(initial_meta), names(metadata))
metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(
    initial_meta %>% select(Run, all_of(cols_to_add)), 
    by = c("sample_id" = "Run")
  )

# 2. Strict standard column sorting array
fixed_cols <- c(
  "pair_id", "pair_time_point", "pair_bioproject", "pair_type", "pair_sample_number", "pair_subject_number", 
  "bioproject", "sample_id", "subject_id", "age", "age_info", "bmi", "sex", "platform", 
  "sequencing_region", "pcr_primers", "country", "site", "site_group", "disease_study", "status", 
  "title", "public_time", "matched_samples", "is_time_series", "age_cleaned", "bmi_cleaned", 
  "age_cleaned_group", "age_info_cleaned", "bmi_cleaned_group", "sex_cleaned", "platform_cleaned", 
  "sequencing_region_cleaned", "country_cleaned", "continent_group", "site_cleaned", 
  "site_group_cleaned", "disease_study_cleaned", "status_cleaned"
)  

metadata <- metadata %>%
  select(all_of(fixed_cols), everything())

# 3. Export to CSV (suppressing automatic row names)
write.csv(metadata, file = "metadata_oral_gut_pair_v2.csv", row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
```
